detail.longDescription:
Here's a conceptual programming question for you:

If I have a static site generator, can I make it federated..? :anime_huh: 

I mean, I think you can set up an RSS feed so that the feed is updated when the site is updated.

Could that be federated? Tied to a federated platform to handle the dynamic aspects, maybe..?

I ask, because when people were asking about better "web comic" platforms, some of the stuff they asked for were my reason for making "LunaGen" for my landing site for serial episode content.

Could it be federated? Does that even make sense? Would I lose the benefits of a static website? 🤔 :raccoon_cool: 

#Programming #Fediverse #ActivityPub #StaticSiteGenerator
